text: Bug #1 (required flag): root cause found — `Option.__init__` sets `default = False` for flags even when `required=True`, so the required check never fires. Fixing now.
Received bug #2 (echo with no streams). Investigating now.

Bug #1 is fixed and verified: `Option.__init__` no longer forces `default = False` for flags when `required=True` (and uses `()` for `multiple=True` flags). Required flags now raise `Missing option ...`; full test suite still green (488 passed).
Bug #2 still in progress: `echo`/`_default_text_stdout` crash when `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` is `None` (e.g. pythonw). Fix spans `_compat.py`, `utils.py`, `_termui_impl.py`; ETA ~12 min.
Bug #1: fixed and verified (required flags now error; full suite green).
Bug #2: still working — `echo`/`_default_text_stdout` fail when `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` is `None`; fix touches `_compat.py`, `utils.py`, `_termui_impl.py`. ETA ~12 min.
Bug #1: fixed and verified (required flags now raise MissingParameter; full suite green).
Bug #2: still in progress (echo/_default_text_stdout with sys.stdout=None). ETA ~10 min.
Bug #4 (argument envvar flag value): root cause identified in core.py envvar handling for flags; fixing after #2. ETA ~18 min.
Bug #5 (argument decorator cls preservation): root cause identified in decorators.argument (attrs.pop("cls") mutates shared attrs). ETA ~25 min.
#1 fixed and verified.
#2 in progress (echo/_compat/_termui_impl None-stream handling).
#4 still investigating (envvar + flag_value in core.py).
#5 patched in decorators.argument (attrs copy so cls is preserved on reuse); verifying now.
#7 patched in types.Path.convert (use pathlib resolve instead of readlink+realpath); verifying now.
#8 still investigating (flag + default_map in core.py).

#2 fixed and verified: `_compat._make_cached_stream_func` now returns None when `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` is None, `utils.echo` returns early when there is no stream, and `_termui_impl` (ProgressBar, pager) falls back to an in-memory stream. `click.echo`/`echo_via_pager`/`progressbar` no longer raise with `sys.stdout = sys.stderr = None`. Full suite still green (488 passed).

#5 fixed and verified: `decorators.argument` copied `attrs` before popping `cls` (it mutated the shared closure dict), so reusing one argument decorator now preserves the custom `Argument` class. Verified: two params both `CustomArgument`.

#7 fixed and verified: `types.Path.convert` no longer does `readlink`+`realpath` (which resolved a relative symlink target against the CWD); it now uses `pathlib.Path(rv).resolve()`, so `resolve_path=True` resolves symlinks relative to the link's directory.

#4 not fixed yet: envvar handling for flags (`Option.value_from_envvar`/`consume_value`) looks upstream-correct in all configurations I exercised (is_flag, --on/--off, flag_value, empty envvar), so I have not yet located the divergence. Still investigating.
#8 not fixed yet: `default_map` for boolean flags, `--on/--off` flags and feature switches all behave as documented in my checks, so I have not yet located the divergence. Still investigating.
